Name: Auto Instant Shipping Box
Author: zedthunder
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
A Portuguese description is available below the English version.

Custom Instant Shipping Box adds a new automatic shipping box to Stardew Valley. It was designed to sell items automatically and support small machine networks by collecting finished products and inserting new inputs when possible.
The box works in two different ways:
When it is [b]isolated[/b], it acts as an automatic shipping box. Any shippable item placed inside will be sold automatically.
When it is [b]next to a machine or connected to a machine network[/b], it works as a machine-support box. In this mode, the first 3 slots are protected for inputs, while the remaining slots are used for collected products and items that can be sold.
This mod was inspired by the automation idea behind Automate, but it [b]does not replace Automate[/b] and should not be used in the same way. Custom Instant Shipping Box sells items automatically, so it is intended for shipping and production support, not general storage.
[line]
[b]Descrição em Português[/b]
Custom Instant Shipping Box adiciona uma nova caixa de remessa automática ao Stardew Valley. Ela foi criada para vender itens automaticamente e ajudar pequenas redes de máquinas, coletando produtos prontos e inserindo novos insumos quando possível.
A caixa funciona de duas formas diferentes:
Quando está [b]isolada[/b], ela age como uma caixa de venda automática. Qualquer item vendável colocado nela será vendido automaticamente.
Quando está [b]ao lado de uma máquina ou conectada a uma rede de máquinas[/b], ela passa a atuar como uma caixa de suporte para automação. Nesse modo, os 3 primeiros slots ficam protegidos para insumos, enquanto os outros slots são usados para produtos coletados e itens que podem ser vendidos.
Este mod foi inspirado na ideia de automação do Automate, mas [b]não substitui o Automate[/b] e não deve ser usado da mesma forma. A Custom Instant Shipping Box vende itens automaticamente, então ela é pensada para remessa e suporte de produção, não para armazenamento geral.
[b]Installation instructions[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download the main mod file.[/*]
[*]Extract the
[code]InstantShippingBox[/code]folder into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]The final folder structure should look like this:
[code]Stardew Valley/
  Mods/
    InstantShippingBox/
      manifest.json
      InstantShippingBox.dll
      assets/
      i18n/[/code]To use the Portuguese translation, install the main file first, then extract the optional Portuguese file over the same
[code]InstantShippingBox[/code]folder.
[b]Main features[/b]
[list]
[*]Adds a craftable Automatic Shipping Box.[/*]
[*]Automatically sells shippable items.[/*]
[*]Works as a shipping box when isolated.[/*]
[*]Works as machine support when connected to a machine network.[/*]
[*]Protects the first 3 slots for inputs when connected to machines.[/*]
[*]Collects finished products from connected machines.[/*]
[*]Feeds connected machines with compatible items.[/*]
[*]Shows a HUD notification with the gold earned.[/*]
[*]Adds a Wizard letter, crafting recipe, and prototype starting in year 2.[/*]
[/list][b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or newer[/*]
[/list]Does not require Content Patcher, Automate, or any other mods.
[b]Shout outs[/b]
Thanks to the Stardew Valley modding community and the SMAPI creators for the tools that make mods like this possible.
Special recognition to Automate as inspiration for the idea of machine networks, even though this mod has a different purpose: automatic shipping and support for small production lines.

[b]Bug Reports[/b]
If you find a bug, please report it in the Bugs section or leave a clear comment on the mod page.
When reporting an issue, please include:
[list]
[*]What happened.[/*]
[*]What you expected to happen.[/*]
[*]Whether the box was isolated or connected to machines.[/*]
[*]Your SMAPI log, if possible.[/*]
[*]A list of mods that may affect machines, shipping, chests, or automation.[/*]
[/list]You can get your SMAPI log here:
[url=https://smapi.io/log]https://smapi.io/log[/url]
